YOUR JOURNEY TO GERMANY
Step by Step – From Your Application to Your First Working Day
Starting a new career in Germany is an exciting opportunity. To help you understand the
process, we have outlined each step below.
Every case is different, but the overall process is generally as follows.

STEP 1
Application & Interview
Your journey begins by submitting your application.
During this stage, EuroJobsCenter will review your qualiﬁcations, driving experience and
documents to determine whether you meet the requirements for employment in
Germany.
You may also be asked to participate in an interview or driving-related assessment.
✔ Submit your documents
✔ Verify your qualiﬁcations
✔ Conﬁrm your work experience
✔ Receive professional guidance

STEP 2
Employment Contract
Once a suitable employer has been found, you will receive an official employment
contract.
Read the contract carefully.
If anything is unclear, ask questions before signing.
Never sign a document that you do not understand.

STEP 3
Application for the German Pre-Approval (Vorabzustimmung)
After the employment contract has been signed, EuroJobsCenter submits your
application to the responsible German Immigration Authority (Ausländerbehörde).
The authority reviews your application and decides whether to issue the official Pre-
Approval (Vorabzustimmung).
This step is an important part of the German immigration process.

STEP 4
Payment of the Official Immigration Authority Fee
The official fee for the German Pre-Approval procedure is EUR 411.
This amount is paid directly by the applicant to the responsible German Immigration
Authority (Ausländerbehörde).
The payment is never made to EuroJobsCenter.
Always verify the bank account details before making any payment.

STEP 5
Pre-Approval Issued
Once the German Immigration Authority approves your application, the official Pre-
Approval (Vorabzustimmung) is issued.
This is an important milestone in your journey to Germany.
After receiving the Pre-Approval, you will receive further instructions regarding the visa
procedure.

STEP 6
Secure Escrow (Trustee) Payment
After the official Pre-Approval has been issued, and no later than before attending your
visa appointment at the German Consulate, the agreed recruitment fee is deposited
with an independent escrow trustee.
This payment system protects both the applicant and EuroJobsCenter.
If your visa is granted, the trustee releases the agreed amount to EuroJobsCenter.
If your visa application is refused, you may request the return of your deposited funds
from the trustee in accordance with the escrow agreement.

STEP 7
Visa Appointment
You will attend your appointment at the German Embassy or German Consulate in your
country.
Bring all required documents.
Answer all questions honestly and conﬁdently.
If necessary, EuroJobsCenter will help you prepare for your appointment.

STEP 8
Visa Issued
Once your visa has been approved, you are ready to prepare for your journey to
Germany.
Congratulations!
You are now only one step away from starting your new career.

STEP 9
Travel to Germany
Book your ﬂight according to the agreed arrival date.
Carry all important documents in your hand luggage, including:
• Passport
• Visa
• Employment Contract
• Driving Licence
• Important contact details
Never place important documents in your checked baggage.

STEP 10
Welcome to Germany
After arriving in Germany, your employer will normally assist you with the ﬁrst important
steps, such as:
• Accommodation
• Registration
• Administrative procedures
• Introduction to the company
• Practical driving assessment
• Preparation for your ﬁrst working day
Your new career in Germany begins.

REMEMBER
Every successful journey begins with one step.
Thousands of international professional truck drivers successfully move to Germany
every year.
Be patient, follow the process, ask questions whenever necessary, and always keep
copies of your important documents.
We look forward to welcoming you to Germany and wish you every success in your new
career.
